name: document-vector-storage
description: Minimalist React app for document upload and vector storage

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev" "cd memvid-service && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.setup:memvid: cd memvid-service && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
